title: 14.34. Niyyānikaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Niyyānikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Aniyyānikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
Niyyānikañca aniyyānikañca dhammaṁ paṭicca naniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve …pe… vipāke ekaṁ …pe… avigate pañca.
